set.body: From the codec review (codec-review 2026-08-28): features/sidecar.scala:27 computes an unchecked Long product; codec avoids it except in SidecarSuite:82. Make it a checked accessor (overflow → Left) or private[features] with a checked public alternative; update the one codec test call. Gate: features + codec JVM/JS/Native.
set.title: features: SidecarManifest.expectedByteLength is an unchecked Long product — make it checked (Either) or private, matching codec's SidecarLayout
